text: Kiara's band is playing the Fleece on May 14. She asked if I could come early and help with the merch table.
Tunde's puppy arrived on Saturday, a ginger cockapoo called Biscuit. He hasn't slept properly since and looks wrecked.
Magda ran the half marathon this morning in just under two hours. Her sister Ilse was at the finish line with a sign.
Remind me to text Zara good luck the day before her piano recital on June 3rd. She said she's been shaking just thinking about it.
Andre and his wife Fern are going to the Arsenal match on 11/2 for their anniversary. Very romantic, apparently.
Need to buy dog food and pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday.

Phoebe's cat Pickle has kidney problems and goes back to the vet on October 28. She's really worried about the cost and about him. I should call her that evening to see how it went. Pickle is fourteen, so she's bracing herself. Her partner thinks they should stop the treatment if it doesn't help, and they've been arguing about it all week.
Chatted with Karim after five-a-side. His daughter has her first gymnastics competition on Sunday and he's more nervous than she is.
Esme's play opens March 6 at the Tobacco Factory. She's got the lead role. Don't forget to send flowers backstage that night.

Efua's mum turns seventy on July 19th. There's a lunch at the Italian place the week after, and Efua wants everyone to keep it a surprise. Efua's brother Tiago is flying in from Lisbon for it, which their mum doesn't know about yet. I offered to bake. Need to check what date Efua wants the cake.
Colm said the triathlon is off because of the flooding. He's gutted but already looking at one in the spring.
Graham Thomas has a dachshund called Ludo who just turned ten. He threw him a little party with sausages.
Naledi is moving to Leeds in December for work. Her partner Owen is staying behind until his contract ends in the spring.
Bethany mentioned she's been learning the cello for about a year now and loves it.
Ask Tiago how the chess tournament went. It was last weekend and I completely forgot to message him afterwards.
Hana got through to the regional final of the spelling bee! It's on April 22 in Manchester, and her dad is driving her down the night before.
Joanna is allergic to nuts and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the dinner.

Callum's grandad died last week. The funeral is on the 30th and Callum is doing a reading. He seemed okay but quieter than usual. I'll check in with him the day after. His girlfriend Anya says he hasn't really talked about it, and his dad is taking it badly too. Might send a card to the family as well.
Rebecca and Jonah are taking their twins to see the Nutcracker on December 20. The kids are obsessed with ballet at the moment.
Anya's rabbit escaped again. Found in next door's garden, unharmed.

Long call with Matilda tonight. Her brother Noah is racing at Brands Hatch on 8/16, his first proper event since the crash two years ago. Their mum refuses to watch, so Matilda's going with his girlfriend instead. She said Noah pretends he isn't scared but he's barely eating. Must text him the morning of the race, and maybe ring Matilda afterwards to hear how it went.
Ximena told me her new kitten is called Churro and he bites everything. She sent about forty photos.
I'm doing the 10k on May 2nd. Need to sort the training plan this week.
Eduardo plays bass in a jazz trio now. They have a residency at the Crown on Thursday nights.
Teresa's son has his grade five violin exam on June 9. She said he's practising for hours every evening and getting quite stressed. Should send him a card the day before.

Kiara mentioned her dog Rolo had surgery on his leg. He's home now but can't do stairs for six weeks. Kiara's been sleeping on the sofa downstairs with him because he cries at night. She's exhausted and has to work from home all week, but says he's being very brave about the cone.
Dinner with Anders and Chloe on Friday. They've just got back from Lisbon and want to show us the photos.
Owen keeps hinting that he'd love a new pair of running shoes for his birthday. Size 10, Brooks.
Zara said her netball team won the county final on Saturday. She scored the winning goal in the last minute! Send her congrats.
Tunde's mum is having her hip done on November 4th. He's taking the week after off to look after her.
Magda Dubois, Mags to everyone at work, is singing in the choir's Christmas concert on December 12. She asked if I'd come along.
Book the car in for its MOT. Garage closes at five.
Grabbed coffee with Phoebe. She's thinking of fostering a greyhound but her landlord hasn't said yes yet.
Colm and his partner Esme are doing the Tough Mudder together on September 7th. Neither of them has trained at all.
Don't forget Andre's birthday is on 2/11. He wants vinyl, ideally something by Fela Kuti.

Callum's sister Bethany has her driving test tomorrow morning. Third attempt. She's terrified. Remind me to text Callum in the afternoon to find out if she passed. Last time she cried in the car park for an hour. Her instructor reckons she's ready this time, and their dad has promised her his old Fiesta if she passes.
Hana's hamster died yesterday. Her little boy is heartbroken, so they're burying it in the garden this weekend.
Anya and Karim got tickets to see Fontaines D.C. in Dublin on March 28. They're flying over the day before and making a weekend of it.
Noah Usman told me he's leaving the orchestra after this season. He wants more time for his kids.
Efua's son is in the school nativity on December 15. He's playing a sheep and is very proud about it.

Talked to Rebecca about the dog show on June 21st. Her spaniel Daisy is entered in the veteran class. Rebecca's nervous; Daisy isn't. I should go along and cheer them on, and take Rebecca for a drink afterwards. Daisy is twelve and this is probably her last show, so it matters a lot to her.
Jonah's band split up. He's not upset, says it had run its course.
Matilda says her dad is still recovering from his heart operation and gets tired easily. She's visiting him every weekend.

Ilse's mum is coming over from Germany on October 30 for a week. Ilse is stressed about cleaning the flat beforehand. Her mum is apparently very particular, and the last visit ended in a row about the kitchen. Ilse's planning a trip to Bath the day after she arrives to keep things calm.
I've booked the theatre for Saturday. Just need to find someone to feed the cat.
Graham's daughter Fern is running the London Marathon in April for a cancer charity. I should sponsor her before the end of the month.
Ximena's quiz team came second at the pub on Tuesday. They're back next week to try again.
Teresa got the part in the community production of Les Mis! Rehearsals start next Monday and the show is May 30.
Ask Chloe if her cat Mochi is eating again. She's had him on a special diet since the scan.

Joanna had her audition for the conservatoire on Wednesday. She thinks it went badly but won't know until mid-November. Message her the week after results come out, whatever happens. She's applying to two other places as a backup. Her teacher, Mrs O'Brien, thinks she's being too hard on herself.
Kiara, Zara and I are all going to the Wolf Alice gig in November. Kiara's sorting the tickets.
Owen works at the vets on Gloucester Road. Might be handy now we've got the puppy.

Eduardo mentioned that his grandmother is turning a hundred next spring and the whole family is flying to Lima for it. He said his aunt Hana is organising everything and is already overwhelmed, and his cousins are fighting about the seating plan. He wants to bring his girlfriend but hasn't asked his mum yet.
Spent the evening sorting out the garage. Found my old football boots.
Tiago's dog Bruno is turning five on January 8. Tiago wants a dog-friendly cake. Don't forget to ask Anya where she got hers.
Sounds like Anders has finally been offered the head coach job at the rowing club. He starts after the regatta on 7/26.
Naledi's parents are celebrating their fortieth anniversary on August 12th. She's making a photo book and asked if I had any old pictures of them. Must dig some out this weekend.
Quick one: Phoebe said Pickle's results came back fine. Huge relief.

Karim's son Tunde is sitting his black belt grading on November 15. Karim says he's been practising in the living room every night. Should ask how it went the next day. Tunde has already failed it once and was really down about it afterwards, so fingers crossed. His mum is bringing a cake either way.
Nothing much to report from the barbecue. Weather held, food was good.
